experiment: Exp6 — Supplementary Poisson Regression on Monthly Counts
description: PoissonRegressor (sklearn, L2-penalized GLM, log link) with GridSearchCV (TimeSeriesSplit n=5, scoring=neg_mean_poisson_deviance). Flattened 6-month window input, identical construction to exp1. Target: raw disappearance count in the target region-month (paper's classifier uses the binarized >0 threshold of this same quantity). Same temporal split as paper (train<=2022-12, test>=2023-01).
